label: CI_VALIDATION_ONLY
what_this_is: The exact signer identity and OIDC issuer a CI-validation signature from .github/workflows/supply-chain.yml on this branch carries. It lets the supply-chain path -- build, SBOM, provenance, keyless signature, verification, tamper refusal -- be exercised end to end on a hosted runner.
what_this_is_not: Not a release trust root. It authorizes no release, no tag and no consumer's trust: the release trust root is QTA_stage9_release_verification/release_trust_policy.json, whose pins stay PENDING until the owner authorizes a release. A signature verified against this file attests origin and integrity of a CI artifact, never scientific validity.
